scope: Read-only inventory of current publishing contracts and Platform Outputs schema before any Item 6 production mutation.

instagram_reel.scenario_name: AP1-IG - Automated Instagram Reel Publisher v2.4 - Generated Cover URL + Offset Fallback
instagram_reel.finding: A create failure schedules retry, but the stage has no transaction/reconciliation identity proving that an ambiguous create did not already publish a Reel before retry.

scenario_names: AP1-IGS - Instagram Story Container Creator v5.2 - Exact Output Webhook
AP1-IGS-POLL - Instagram Story Container Poll + Publish v1.3 - Exact Output Webhook
instagram_story.finding: Container creation and media_publish are exact-output addressed, but there is no cross-attempt replacement transaction identity or last-good snapshot.

scenario_names: AP4C - Publish Instagram Carousel Parent v1.0
AP4R - Reconcile Ambiguous Instagram Carousel Publish v1.0.1
AP5C - Finalize Instagram Carousel Publish v1.0.1
instagram_carousel.finding: Carousel already has a useful ambiguity-reconciliation primitive, but it commits directly into the primary published fields and does not preserve a previous last-good publication during replacement.

scenario_names: FB1 - Create Facebook Unpublished Photo Objects v1.5 - Temporary Media + View-Decoupled Search
FB2 - Publish Facebook 4x5 Image Post v1.5 - Binary Response Field Mapping Fix
FB2R - Reconcile Ambiguous Facebook Page Publish v1.1 - Orchestrator-Owned Handoff
FB3 - Finalize Facebook Page Post v1.0.2 - Use Graph Permalink URL
facebook.finding: Facebook has the strongest existing single-attempt duplicate defense: package revision, pre-publish fingerprint, and ambiguous-post reconciliation. It still lacks a cross-revision last-good/pending replacement transaction and obsolete-object cleanup state.

scenario_names: TTD1 - Initialize TikTok Draft Delivery v1.0.2 - Valid Photo JSON
TTD2 - Poll TikTok Draft Processing v1.0.1
TTD4 - TikTok Manual Completion Handler v1.0.1 - TikTok URL Guard
tiktok.finding: TTD1 refuses reinitialization once TikTok_Draft_Publish_ID exists and TTD2 stores TikTok_Draft_Public_Post_IDs_JSON. Manual completion can finalize a URL, but there is no transactional old-vs-new publication model or deterministic cleanup contract.

scenario_names: YT0 - Validate and Prepare YouTube Package v1.4 - YTP1 Handoff
YTP1 - Start YouTube Upload v1.4 - Public Publish Asset First
YTS1 - Poll YouTube Upload Job v1.2 - Retryable Poll Errors + Terminal Job Failure
YTS2 - Poll YouTube Processing and Optional Thumbnail v1.4 - Auto JPEG Under 2MB
YTS3 - Finalize YouTube Publish v1.1 - Existing Setting Alignment
youtube.finding: The original upload chain is idempotency-keyed, but replacement needs revision/transaction-scoped idempotency so a new master can intentionally create one new upload without replaying or colliding with the prior publication.

fixture_inventory.decision: Create a new isolated Item 6 fixture. Do not reuse Outputs 135-137 or Output 151.

next_gate: Define and implement a minimal transaction contract that preserves the old publication until the replacement is verified, is idempotent by transaction/revision, separates commit from cleanup, blocks cross-record/test identity drift, and routes unsupported cleanup to an explicit manual-cleanup state instead of guessing.
